card.name: Last digit of a number range
card.fires_on: A single digit that ends a number, usually the second number in a range or a decimal, just before a unit such as g/dL, mL, mg/dL or hours.

modes.label: Digit ending a range
modes.description: The final digit of the upper number in a range like 14 to 15.5 or 22 to 23 hours.

modes.label: Decimal or percent digit
modes.description: A digit inside a decimal or percent value before a unit.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it may push toward unit words like hour after a number.
card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a number or range just before its unit, like g/dL or hours.
